entries.title: Ruth 1:1
segments:
The land; Palestine. 
 
  Moab; a country south-east of Palestine. 
 
Men are dependent on God for the comforts of this life, as well as the life to come; and without his blessing, notwithstanding all human efforts, the earth would never yield a harvest.

entries.title: Ruth 1:2
segments:
Ephrathites; Bethlehem was called Ephratah, and its inhabitants Ephrathites. 
 
To remove, from a regard to worldly circumstances merely, out of a land of religious light and privileges to a land of darkness and idolatry, is a course full of danger, and likely to terminate in distress.

entries.title: Ruth 1:5
segments: A state of widowhood is one of peculiar trials, which calls for, and should receive, peculiar sympathy and aid.

entries.title: Ruth 1:6
segments: All our blessings are the gift of God; they should be sought from him, and in the reception of them his goodness should be daily acknowledged.

entries.title: Ruth 1:9
segments: The marriage of daughters with husbands who will give them a peaceful, pleasant, and useful home, is desired by wise and pious parents, not only for the good of their daughters, but of all who may feel their influence.

entries.title: Ruth 1:14
segments: Pious relatives may conduct with such wisdom and kindness as, with the blessing of God, to endear themselves to those who have no religion; and this they should desire, for the purpose of doing them good.

entries.title: Ruth 1:15
segments: Her gods; the idols which her countrymen worshipped.

entries.title: Ruth 1:16
segments:
Thy God my God; in this she expressed her determination to embrace and adhere to the Jewish religion. 
 
Fixed and strong resolution is necessary in order truly to serve God, and those who love him will, when called to it, give up all for his sake.

entries.title: Ruth 1:20
segments:
Naomi; meaning pleasant. 
 
  Mara; bitter. 
 
True piety will lead men to see and acknowledge the hand of God in their mercies and in their trials; to be thankful for the one and submissive under the other, and to endeavor in both to honor him.
